call_points.text: Order book at the end of FY26 stood at ₹89.59 crores, up 34% compared to ₹66.64 crores in FY25.
FY26 EBITDA margin compressed to 8.2% due to US tariff headwinds, one-time labor provisioning, and higher exhibition costs.
The company remained debt-free with cash on hand at ₹69.26 crores by the end of FY26.
U.S. business declined by close to 50% in absolute terms during FY26 due to tariff issues.

guidance.statement: We think that conservatively we should deliver about 15% higher top line as compared to current year.

timeline.summary: Mamata Machinery scheduled its Q4 and FY26 earnings conference call for June 1, 2026.
Q4FY26 results (consolidated): revenue ₹73.75 Cr (-33.6% YoY), net profit ₹0.01 Cr (-100.0% YoY).
Mamata Machinery reported FY26 consolidated revenue of ₹233 Cr and PAT of ₹15.05 Cr, impacted by US tariff headwinds.
Mahendra N. Patel, Promoter, declared no encumbrances on 15,367,570 Mamata Machinery shares by promoter group for FY2026.

Mamata Machinery said it was granted European Patent No. 4467325 (EP 4467325 B1) for its Multi-Purpose Sealing Module, published May 13, 2026; the technology is already patented in India with a US application filed.
Mamata Machinery hosted its Q4 and FY26 earnings call, reporting an 8% revenue decline due to US tariff headwinds and guiding for ~15% growth in FY27.
Mamata Machinery received APR Design® for Recyclability Recognition in the United States for its RecTech packaging film.
